classification_policy: Each registration is static and independent by kind+type. Schema expressions are factory-local lexical setting references, not exhaustive validation or support claims; authoritative full settings remainder is provider_source including nested/shared schema. Unlisted settings within every partial subset remain unverified; unsupported controls are not stored as successful runtime effects.

broker_network_owner.native_effects: EC2 reserves real per-broker IPv4 ENI capacity and derives live SG/NACL/routes via existing compute/network.Specification. Kafka owner must apply native policy and attach real broker endpoint before readiness.
broker_network_owner.identity: Exact scoped cluster ARN + retained incarnation + positive one-based broker ID; private NetworkOwnerCreation + NetworkControlOwnerID reuse existing schema; no public tag/description authority.
broker_network_owner.settings_remainder: DEFAULT 2/3 unique standard AZ subnets one VPC only; no IPv6/Express/public access/custom broker distribution assertion. Native broker producer/consumer and IAM SLR integration unverified by this owner.
